description:
North star: compile work proportional to input; things nothing uses create no work or artifacts.

Fact (develop 28c59e780): `def main(), do: 1 + 2` touches fz_op_add_if/ff (4 jobs each) through the unselected clauses of Kernel.+/2 (lib/kernel.fz:291-293).

Design (proposal ../fz-xxd.10.html; approved 2026-10-07; evidence scratch xxd10/r6, r7, r8):
- R1 self-keyed rows: a row with no variables that convergence_class_at (both flags) and erase_closure_identity leave unchanged keys as itself and asks no Recursive/InputDemand (World::self_keyed_activation). One gate require_activation_key_facts(root, f, row) replaces the copies in jobs/root.rs, backend.rs, callable_target.rs and semantic.rs.
- Same-pass keying: when a direct callee's prerequisites are unmet, the caller also asks the callee's keying facts for the row it holds, in the same pass, for every callee (contract or not); the ask after contract refinement is the correctness gate. The same for protocol targets in resolve_protocol_call. Measured: the early ask costs 1 job across 665 fixtures (callee-side per-row fact: +17,000 jobs, 43 rises; rejected).
- R3 transport on-cycle: an edge is on a cycle when the callee executable reaches the owner through settled ExecutableFacts call-site targets (direct arm: direct edges only, skipping ClosureCallReturn origins; closure arm: all edges). Cut rule (callee id <= owner id) unchanged. Reading reach once per evaluation is the stacked ticket fz-xxd.13.
- R4 body shape from source: extern-ness and @spec read from the scoped FunctionSource heads; undefined_gate deleted; DeriveFunctionContract gated on FunctionDefined; a caller waits once for {Contract if declared, LoweredBody unless extern}.
- E1 an extern is a leaf: its StaticCallees is empty and the forwarding walk does not read its body (from its source head, by body shape).
- M2 module stage: analyze_activation_gates asks ModuleDefined for the direct callees of the lowered body it reads (static_edges), so a callee in an undefined module costs no discovery run.
- Recursive(f) = f reaches itself through StaticCallees (job DeriveRecursive). Deleted: FactKey::CallGraphComponent, CallGraphComponentMap and accessors, the component half of publish_call_graph_node, old_cut, statically_reaches, settled_component (with R3 nothing reads the component).

Prediction (probe V3 on develop): 1+2 jobs 144 -> 102, 0 on fz_op_add_if/ff; census 665 fixtures 171,748 -> 136,880 jobs, AnalyzeActivation 32,052 -> 32,207, no fixture rises, outputs identical; main/0 analyses equal develop on ladder, 00420, 00568, json, p1, s1, s3, closure_capture_requirement_projection, keyword_surface, mailbox_closure_enum_hofs, enum_surface, term_ordering; backend byte-identical on ladder, json, p1, s1, s3.

Red ledger on the port (xxd10/r7/ledger.md): 15 intended drops (pins restated with predicted values), 3 staging (expected green unchanged with same-pass), 1 harness gap (world_test must publish FunctionDefined through the production path).

Debris at landing: fz-xxd.12 (scalar rows) is subsumed by R1 - verify and close; fz-afu.8 description names CallGraphComponent and statically_reaches - rewrite for Recursive; keying.rs comment citing fz-kdt.213 is rewritten (see the filed ticket for its cont<->step ascent).

Gate: census no rise, outputs identical, the five gate lines. Wall clock is gated on the stack top with fz-xxd.13.
title: Nothing unused creates work: a static edge exists only from a clause dispatch can select
